patterns.name: comment.line.asterisk.natural
patterns.comment: Full-line comment: * or ** at the start of a line (leading whitespace allowed, matching the lexer's line-start rule).

patterns.name: comment.line.double-slash.natural
patterns.comment: Rest-of-line comment introduced by /* anywhere on the line; runs to end of line, no closing */.

numbers.name: constant.numeric.natural
numbers.comment: Integer, decimal, and scientific-notation numeric literals.

patterns.name: keyword.control.natural
patterns.comment: Recognized Natural statement keywords (case-insensitive). Deliberately basic.

patterns.name: keyword.other.natural
patterns.comment: Declaration/section and clause words that read as modifiers rather than statement heads.
